profile.headline: Contact Center Engineer (Genesys , Google GCP )
profile.summary:
I am sociable, friendly, self-controlled and like to challenge myself to improve my skill. I am eager to learn new skills. I have a proven record of cooperating and collaborating with colleagues at all levels, a skill so essential to meeting critical deadline and towards team's success.

Looking to excel in career and as a person.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Engineering · Contact Centers · Call Routing · Dialogflow · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Genesys PureEngage · CCAIP · SDLC · Agile Methodologies · Team Leadership · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Communication · Technical Support · Chatbot Development · Web Chat · Chatbot Testing · Interactive Voice Response (IVR)

positions.title: Genesys Platform engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Genesys Platform as Platform engineer in for multitenant environment.
Duties cover installation, configuration, deployments and support Genesys Platform.
Experience with Linux/Unix OS system administration, configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, preventative maintenance, and security procedures.
Support our ever growing needs across the enterprise. 
Determine configuration and operational requirements for development team. Working knowledge of production support processes, using Remedy for incident/change/problem management and ticketing workflow. 
Provided health checks specific to the Genesys environment in order to optimize performance /stability and participate in the 24x7 on-call rotation.

positions.title: Genesys Administrator / Systems Integrator
positions.description:
OpenMind Technologies is a globalized software solutions and product company.
Consulting for Genesys since april 2013.

positions.title: Genesys Systems Integrator
positions.description:
Celgene a major biotech company. Purpose is to provide a comprehensive overview of IVR solution to the current project and supporting its infrastructure.
Primary role to support implementation of Genesys Solutions in DEV and progress it to other environments.
Support test team to carry out testing help write test case and walk through whole testing process.
Support and convert WAV file to VOX for IVR
Create user references manual document and update as per requirement changes. Providing DEMO of product time to time helping user group to use tool and application.

positions.title: Genesys (CTI) Developer / Systems Integrator
positions.description:
GENESYS AND CONSULTING IN GENESYS SINCE 2008. 
IMPLEMENTED COMPUTER TELEPHONY INTEGRATION (CTI), WITHIN THE INSURANCE, FINANCIAL, EDUCUATION, AIRLINE, AND TELEMARKETING INDUSTRIES.

positions.title: Genesys (CTI) Developer / Systems Integrator
positions.description:
The implementation of Genesys Solutions extends the functionality of Large Online Education management corporation using Genesys Gplus adapter for Microsoft CRM and the Genesys Outbound solution will utilize existing telephony infrastructure to route calls to agents and contact customers. 
Replacement of older Agent Softphone with Gplus Adapter  with Genesys 8.0 environment .
Assistance from additional members on his team, Genesys Support and Genesys Engineering, addressed each problematic area one by one with the customer’s involvement, for an overall resolution and proper blended outbound solutions and deployment. And assist on pre and post deployment process on site and remote on environment.
Supported Quality assurances process for QA team for various test cycles to carryout testing on Functionality of Genesys Gplus Adapter 
Install and upgraded Genesys environment from 7.6 to 8.0. Genesys Gplus Adapter for MSCRM provides softphone functionality that integrates MSCRM with the Genesys solution suite.
Create user references manual document and update as per requirement changes. Providing DEMO of product time to time helping user group to use tool and application.

positions.title: Genesys Developer
positions.description: The aim of this project is to build the CTI application using Genesys Platform SDK which gives combine Real Time Reports for the Contact Center in environment.
